sections.kicker: Prepared for Granite Ridge Builders by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Granite Ridge has named homes and its own show. The words around them are the ones every builder uses.
sections.keep: The Breckenridge Lodge at dusk on the site. It looks like a home worth walking through.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet

pins.quote: We design & build custom homes tailored to your life.
pins.what: The bio says Granite Ridge builds custom homes tailored to your life.
pins.why: Every custom builder says this. It does not say why Granite Ridge and not the builder in the next subdivision.
pins.how: Say what a Granite Ridge home feels like that others do not, with the lodge and the named models as proof.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Buyers compare builders on floor plans and price because nothing else is on offer.

pins.what: Between the Studs is a show only Granite Ridge makes, and the site files it as one more menu item.
pins.why: A builder that films its own process has something no other builder has.
pins.how: Let the show be how the brand introduces itself, not a link.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: The one thing that shows how Granite Ridge works gets the same weight as Contact.

pins.quote: distinctive architecture, thoughtful interior design, and spaces created for gathering
pins.what: Captions describe each home with words every builder uses.
pins.why: Lodge, Monaco, Greyson Heights: the models have names and the words around them do not.
pins.how: Write one sentence per model about who it is for and what it feels like to walk in.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: The named homes read as floor plans.
